description: Onto Innovation is a semiconductor process-control equipment company providing inspection, metrology (precision measurement), lithography, and software solutions used to verify and control chip fabrication at the nanometer scale. Its systems are used at leading-edge fabs to measure structural dimensions in gate-all-around transistors, high-bandwidth memory cells, and advanced packaging interconnects. In 2025-2026, Onto invested $710 million for a 27% equity stake in Rigaku Holdings to expand into hybrid X-ray metrology, targeting a $1 billion+ addressable market. The company's flagship Atlas G6 OCD metrology platform targets second-generation GAA logic and DRAM nodes for AI chips.
